plugins.name: spaitial-ai
plugins.description: Generate and edit explorable 3D Gaussian-splat worlds from a text prompt, image, 360 panorama, or iterative pano edit using the SpAItial API — via the hosted SpAItial MCP server (bring-your-own-key). Create worlds, edit panoramas, check status, download splats, export meshes, and manage your library, then preview them via hosted viewer links.

skills.name: create-world
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to generate a 3D world, scene, or Gaussian splat with SpAItial — e.g. "make a 3D world of…", "turn this photo into a 3D scene", "generate a splat from this image", "create a world from a text prompt", or "build a world from this 360 panorama". Handles text prompts, image URLs, local image files, and equirectangular panoramas; submits the job through the SpAItial MCP server, waits for it to finish, returns the hosted viewer link and thumbnail, and downloads the splat. Triggers on mentions of spaitial, world generation, .spz/.sog splat files, or 3D scene generation from an image.
headings: Step 1 — Make sure the connector is set up
Export a mesh / manage the world
skills.description_zh: 通过 SpAItial MCP 从文字、图片 URL、本地图片或等距柱状全景生成 3D 世界、场景或 Gaussian splat，等待完成后提供托管查看链接、缩略图并下载 splat。

skills.name: edit-world
skills.description: Use this skill when the user wants to edit or restyle an existing SpAItial world through the app-style panorama edit flow — e.g. "change the rug to yellow", "remove that object", "add this sofa", "make this room cyberpunk", "iterate on this world", or "create a new world from this edited pano". Edits the world panorama, supports up to 3 reference images, lets the user inspect each pano_ result, and finally creates a new world from the accepted panorama.
skills.description_zh: 通过全景编辑流程修改既有 SpAItial 世界的物体、颜色和风格，支持最多三张参考图，让用户检查各 pano 结果，再从接受的全景创建新世界。

skills.name: export-mesh
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants a polygon mesh from a finished SpAItial world — e.g. "export a mesh of req_…", "give me the .ply mesh", "I need a mesh for Blender / Unreal / Unity", "export a simplified / low-poly mesh", or "convert my world to a 3D model". Starts a mesh export through the SpAItial MCP server, waits for it to finish, and downloads the .ply file (full-resolution or simplified). Use create-world to generate the world first and manage-worlds to find a world's request_id.
skills.description_zh: 通过 SpAItial MCP 将已完成世界导出为全分辨率或简化 .ply 多边形网格，等待完成并下载，供 Blender、Unreal、Unity 等使用。先创建世界，request_id 通过 manage-worlds 查找。

skills.name: manage-worlds
skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to view or manage worlds they already generated with SpAItial — e.g. "list my worlds", "show my recent generations", "check the status of req_…", "is my world done yet?", "rename this world", "make world req_… public / private / listed", "share my world", or "cancel that running job". Lists jobs, polls status, downloads existing splats/panoramas, updates title and visibility, and cancels in-flight jobs via the SpAItial MCP server. Use the companion create-world skill to generate new worlds and export-mesh to produce mesh files.
headings: Download an existing splat or panorama
skills.description_zh: 通过 SpAItial MCP 查看管理已生成世界，列出任务、查询状态、下载既有 splat 或全景、修改标题和公开私有可列出状态、分享或取消运行任务。新世界及网格分别由 create-world 和 export-mesh 处理。
